environment.hardware: CPU-only extraction and nearest-neighbour analysis; isolated F: environment

title: RADIATE fog vehicle-footprint LiDAR support and radar contrast diagnostic
sensor_configuration: Navtech 2D radar Cartesian images and nearest Velodyne HDL-32e LiDAR; static published calibration, <=50 ms timing gate
annotation_schema: Radar-annotated rotated BEV vehicle footprints; no terrain or 3D height labels
split: 17 paired frames of 18 available; 39 observations, four tracks, one approximately four-second fog recording
notes: Descriptive evidence, not detection recall or sensor accuracy. Radar-derived labels favour radar-visible targets; no clear-weather control. Radar image contrast and LiDAR return counts are different measures. Includes 1 m footprint, neighbouring LiDAR scans, stricter contrast thresholds and unlabelled rotated controls; controls are not verified negatives.

measurements.name: Paired frames
measurements.scope: One public fog sequence; one timing exclusion
